title: La Tienda de Mineral del Chico, MEXITV
comment: tienda-mineral (MEXITV): tiendita de abarrotes vieja en una calle empedrada de Mineral del Chico, Hidalgo, de mañana, recién reabierta. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ITZEL_IBANEZ: Mexican woman from the city, 28 years old, light-brown skin, shoulder-length straight black hair with bangs, determined dark eyes, a mustard-yellow knit sweater, jeans, white sneakers, small silver hoop earrings, her hands empty.
chars.EUTIMIO_SOTO: Mexican old man, kind and fearful neighbor, 73 years old, brown wrinkled skin, white stubble, thick glasses, a grey wool flat cap, a brown cardigan over a plaid shirt, grey trousers, his hands empty.
chars.GUERO_VALDES: Mexican man, the local boss's errand man, 35 years old, fair skin, short bleached-blond hair, a light stubble, an arrogant smirk, a black leather jacket over a grey t-shirt, jeans, cowboy boots, dark sunglasses pushed up on his head, his hands empty.
chars.MAXIMINO_UGARTE: Mexican man, the feared local boss of the town, 66 years old, tanned skin, thick white hair combed back, a white mustache, deep-set dark eyes, a black suede jacket over a white shirt, a black felt cowboy hat, a gold ring, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_TIENDAMINERAL: Old small general store in Mineral del Chico, Hidalgo, in the misty morning: worn wooden counter, old wooden shelves with glass jars of candy, dusty cans and bottles, a hanging old scale, colorful painted walls with peeling paint, a wide open door onto a steep cobblestone street with pine-covered mountains and fog, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
